suggestions.text: Track receipt-reconstructability ratio: for each of the next 20 cycles, score whether the cycle output can be reconstructed from receipts alone or requires re-reading the source prompt. The ratio measures auditability of the loop's own non-deterministic compilation.

Build the first repo-pattern classifier slice: read context/trending-repos.md and emit one JSONL row per repo with custody_type, raw_object, admitted_object, stable_surface, volatile_substrate, authority_owner, evidence_artifact, fallback_or_recovery_path, and demotion_rule.

Compare the last five essays for compilation-related vocabulary versus genuinely new structural observations; the invisible-compilation frame risks becoming the next post-hoc explanation engine if every input gets compiled through it.
